uc1.title: Use case 1 — Temporal dynamics
uc1.alt: Use case 1 — Temporal dynamics: annual growth of light
uc1.caption: Between 2014 and 2025, night-time light in Lesotho changed by +5.8% per year (95% CI: +3.3% to +8.1%). Over the last 12 months, the seasonally adjusted level is +10.2% relative to the previous 12 months. (confidence high: significant trend (p < 0.01; n = 12))
uc1.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine

uc3.title: Use case 3 — Lights and GDP
uc3.alt: Use case 3 — Lights and GDP: light–GDP elasticity
uc3.caption: The elasticity of light with respect to real GDP is −0.33 in levels (95% CI: −3.41 to 2.75, R² = 0.00, 12 years) and −0.19 in growth rates (CI: −1.82 to 1.44). Out of sample, light growth tracks GDP growth with a correlation of −0.96 (mean absolute error: 3.6 percentage points of growth). (confidence low: n = 12, not significant (p = 0.83))

uc4.title: Use case 4 — Economic shocks
uc4.alt: Use case 4 — Economic shocks: shock trough
uc4.caption: The most pronounced shock in the seasonally adjusted series is “COVID-19”: trough of -14.2% (12/2020), return to the pre-shock level after 12 months. (confidence low: trough compared with pre-shock month-to-month variability)
uc4.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine

uc5.title: Use case 5 — Inequality & access
uc5.alt: Use case 5 — Inequality & access: of residents in the dark
uc5.caption: The Gini coefficient of light per capita (ADM2) is 0.53 in 2025 (significant decrease since 2014). About 0.03 million people live in inhabited areas with no detectable light (39% of the inhabited population). (confidence medium: sensitive to the radiance threshold (from 0.03 to 0.04 M depending on the threshold); a proxy for outdoor lighting, not for grid connection)

uc6.title: Use case 6 — Industrial zones
uc6.alt: Use case 6 — Industrial zones: industrial clusters
uc6.caption: 12 industrial clusters detected from concordant satellite signals: 3 heavy industry, 2 business parks & logistics, 2 oil & gas sites and 5 isolated sites to verify. They emit 16.0% of national light (latest year); their light changes by +1.0% per year. Maseru District has the most industrial activity. (confidence low: precision 92% and recall 22% against the reference list)
